info.title: sys-dock
info.author: masagrator
info.description: Enable higher docked display bandwidth and refresh rates.
info.details:
sys-dock is a sysmodule that patches docked DisplayPort link training to allow higher-bandwidth display modes and higher refresh rates.

It's primarily intended for use alongside FPSLocker, especially on OLED models where the default docked DisplayPort configuration can limit available refresh rates. The included overlay lets you enable or disable individual DisplayPort patches and see which patches are currently active.

Configuration is stored in `sd:/config/sys-dock/config.ini` and can be edited manually or through the overlay.

Because sys-dock changes low-level dock and display behavior, incompatible docks, displays, cables, or patch combinations may cause display corruption, instability, or other unexpected behavior.

changelog:
1.0.2

- Introduce a patch `force_full_render_pass` that solves an issue some people had with glitched horizontal lines while using high refresh rate at 1080p. Confirmed with OLED, V2 and V1.
  - Removed redocking feature, use this patch instead.
